title: stand-test KB ingestion - source document
description: One ingested unstructured specification (docx/pdf/markdown/txt/html). This is STAGING metadata, NEVER routed through stand-test-knowledge-base.schema.json. It records the provenance root and a re-ingest hash. It carries no secret values and no URLs - sourcePath is a repo-relative path under the gitignored _source/ tree, not a URL. File shape: { document: {...} }.

noUrl.description: No URLs, no JDBC strings - even in identity/label fields. Null-safe: only constrains strings.

documentId.description: Stable kebab-case id, mechanically derived from the file name/title. Also the candidates/<documentId>/ directory name. The same document re-derives the same id.

sourcePath.description: Repo-relative path to the original binary under the gitignored candidates/<documentId>/_source/raw/ tree. Never a URL/JDBC string.

sourceHash.description: sha256 of the exact source the extraction ran against - used to detect a repeated ingest of the same bytes.
